Help build the Garage.

Builder Garage is maintainer-led and community-contributed. GitHub is where changes are proposed and reviewed.

Ways to help

Report a problem, propose a change, request discovery, improve documentation, or test a candidate practice. For an existing issue, request assignment and wait for a maintainer before starting.

Open an issue ↗

Your first contribution →

How a change moves

Open ordinary implementation pull requests against staging; main is the release branch. Substantive changes pass independent engineering review before a pull request, then maintainer approval before merge. Neither replaces the other. External contributors can run implementation and review in separate execution contexts and post both records on the originating issue.

Human product-intent acceptance also applies. Inspecting user-facing results is required when the documented trigger holds. A sole maintainer's own pull request uses the documented explicit-acceptance exception, not a self-approving review.
